reader_question: Which federal agencies gained or lost civilian employees?
grade_line: Documented: the Office of Personnel Management’s records of federal employees
title: Federal agencies in the personnel files had 130,369 fewer civilian employees in August 2026 than in January 2022, and 33 of the 37 with 1,000 or more shrank.
reading_guide: A bar to the left of zero is an agency that lost employees, and a bar to the right one that gained. Each figure sits across the zero line from its bar.
measure_line: Change in federal civilian employees by department or agency, January 31, 2022 to August 31, 2026, people, for the 37 agencies with 1,000 or more employees on either date. The window starts in January 2022, as the guide’s jobs charts do, and ends in August 2026, the latest month the Office of Personnel Management did not flag as incomplete.
notes: Each bar nets every hire and departure between January 31, 2022 and August 31, 2026, so it hides any rise and fall inside the window.
The 37 agencies drawn held 99.4 percent of employees in January 2022. The table lists all 129 agencies in the files, where a small agency can show a large percent change.

The files count people on the rolls on one day, full-time and part-time alike. They leave out intelligence agencies, the Postal Service and some others that do not report to the Office of Personnel Management.
Agency names are shortened from the August 2026 file, which still calls the largest the Department of Defense.
alt: Diverging bar chart of the change in civilian employees at 37 federal agencies from January 2022 to August 2026. Defense lost 73,248, the most, followed by Health and Human Services, Treasury and the Social Security Administration. Four gained: Veterans Affairs 21,956, Homeland Security 14,584, Interior 275 and the Government Publishing Office 88. All agencies in the files together lost 130,369.

table.caption: Federal civilian employees by agency, January 2022 and August 2026

chart_notes: Bars: Prussian blue to the left of zero for a loss, Verdigris green to the right for a gain. The scale runs from −80,000 to +40,000.
Above the bars: all agencies in the files, −130,369.
